result.description:
Technical Writer contract opportunity for a state gov department   Your new company    Join a large Queensland-based public sector organisation delivering a significant business transformation program aimed at improving governance, financial management, asset lifecycle management, and project delivery capability. Supporting a substantial infrastructure portfolio and investment program, this transformation initiative will establish stronger frameworks, processes, and controls to enhance organisational performance and long-term service delivery outcomes.    Your new role     
 As the Technical Writer, you will play a key role in developing, editing, and maintaining controlled documentation across a major transformation program. Working closely with subject matter experts, project teams, and senior stakeholders, you will translate complex technical, financial, and operational information into clear, accessible, and user-friendly documentation. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Developing and maintaining governance, planning, assurance, and project management documentation. 
 Creating process maps, templates, guidance materials, procedures, checklists, and knowledge resources. 
 Preparing financial management documentation, reporting tools, and user guidance materials. 
 Writing, reviewing, and editing technical documentation to a publishable standard. 
 Assisting with executive briefing papers, reports, and business improvement documentation. 
 Producing stakeholder communications, training materials, and change management resources. 
 Conducting quality assurance reviews and maintaining version-controlled document repositories. 
 Collaborating with subject matter experts to define documentation requirements and ensure content accuracy. 
 Promoting documentation standards and continuous improvement across the program. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Extensive experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Specialist, or similar role within complex project or program environments. 
 Strong experience developing, editing, and maintaining high-quality technical and business documentation. 
 Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to communicate complex information to non-technical audiences. 
 Experience producing governance, process, policy, framework, reporting, or project-related documentation. 
 Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills. 
 Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes within tight timeframes. 
 Experience working collaboratively with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and project teams. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to contribute to a high-profile business transformation program. 
 Exposure to complex governance, financial management, and infrastructure initiatives. 
 Collaborative and supportive team environment. 
 The chance to work alongside senior stakeholders and subject matter experts across multiple business functions. 
 A rewarding contract opportunity where your work will have a direct impact on program delivery, organisational capability, and long-term business improvement outcomes. 
 
  What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description: REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS   REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of   Rushlee Pty Ltd  ,   Geelong VIC 3220   Join Rushlee as a Systems Administrator, where you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting the organisation's IT infrastructure, networks, servers, and business systems to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations. The role involves monitoring system performance, troubleshooting technical issues, managing user access, implementing cybersecurity measures, and supporting technology upgrades. This position is integral to maintaining business continuity, enhancing operational efficiency, and providing a stable technology environment that supports Rushlee's workforce and ongoing business growth.   Benefits   Competitive remuneration   Full-time, stable employment with a growing, locally owned business  Supportive team environment with a focus on safety and professionalism    Task & responsibilities   Install, configure, administer, and maintain the organisation's servers, operating systems, business applications, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure operations.  Monitor the performance, availability, and security of IT systems and networks, proactively identifying and resolving issues to minimise downtime.  Manage user accounts, access permissions, email services, and authentication controls in accordance with organisational security policies.  Provide technical support to employees by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and system-related issues in a timely manner.  Implement, maintain, and monitor cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, endpoint protection, system updates, backups, and disaster recovery processes to safeguard organisational data.  Perform routine system maintenance, software upgrades, security patching, and configuration management to optimise system performance and reliability.  Administer and maintain databases, data storage solutions, and backup systems to ensure data integrity, availability, and secure information management.  Develop and maintain IT documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and asset registers to support effective system administration.  Liaise with external technology vendors and service providers to coordinate system maintenance, software licensing, technical support, and infrastructure upgrades.  Support and maintain business technology including workstations, mobile devices, telecommunications systems, printers, and remote access solutions.  Assist management in planning, implementing, and improving IT infrastructure and technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.  Ensure all IT systems and practices comply with organisational policies, privacy obligations, cybersecurity standards, and other applicable regulatory requirements.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, Systems Administration, or a related field.  Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant work experience (or equivalent part-time/casual experience) in systems administration, IT support, or network administration.  Demonstrated experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and business IT systems.  Sound knowledge of networking technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routers, switches, and wireless networks.  Experience managing system security, backups, disaster recovery, and software updates.  Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network environments.  Excellent organisational, communication, and time management skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively while providing technical support to end users.  Knowledge of information security, data privacy, and compliance requirements, with healthcare or community services experience being advantageous.   About Company     Rushlee Pty Ltd is a Geelong-based information technology company specialising in network infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud networking, IT support, and system administration services. The company provides reliable and secure technology solutions to businesses across various industries. With a strong focus on innovation, network performance, and customer service, Rushlee Pty Ltd supports the design, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of business-critical IT systems and network environments. Working with a diverse range of clients, you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality accounting, taxation, and business advisory services while helping businesses make informed financial decisions.  From preparing financial statements and tax returns to providing valuable financial insights, you'll work alongside experienced professionals in a supportive and collaborative environment. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career with a respected accounting practice.  The successful applicant will have strong taxation and compliance experience, excellent client relationship skills, and demonstrated knowledge of NSW Land Tax requirements. Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Windsor region or surrounding suburbs.      Benefits  The position offers a competitive salary package of AUD $79,500 - $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, professional development opportunities, career progression and a supportive team environment.   Task & responsibilities  • Manage a portfolio of accounting and taxation clients.  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients.  • Prepare financial statements and tax returns.  • Assist in preparing budgets, cash flow forecasts and accounting policies for clients.  • Prepare financial statements and reports for clients, management and regulatory purposes.  • Prepare and lodge BAS, IAS and other compliance documents.  • Assist clients with budgeting, cash flow forecasts and financial reports.  • Provide advice on Land Tax and taxation matters.  • Liaise with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other government agencies.  • Assist with Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) and payroll compliance.  • Prepare management reports and identify financial issues for clients.  • Maintain and improve accounting systems and advise clients on accounting software and financial processes.  • Review financial information and ensure compliance with accounting standards and legislative requirements.  • Assist in maintaining internal control procedures and risk management processes.  • Build and maintain strong client relationships while providing ongoing accounting and business advisory support.  • Support clients with general accounting and business advisory services.  • Keep up to date with changes in accounting and tax legislation.               Qualification & experience  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline.  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in an accounting role  • Must have either completed or be pursuing CA or related qualification  • Strong knowledge of Australian taxation, BAS and accounting principles.  • Knowledge of NSW Land Tax requirements is essential.  • Strong communication and client relationship management skills.  • Experience using accounting software and Microsoft Office applications.  • Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Windsor region or surrounding suburbs.  About Company    Peter Vickers and Associates Pty Ltd (ABN 60 003 466 813) is a well-established accounting and business advisory firm based in Windsor, NSW. We provide professional accounting, taxation, superannuation and business advisory services to individuals, families and businesses across a broad range of industries. Our team is committed to delivering tailored financial solutions, exceptional client service and practical business advice. We foster a collaborative and supportive workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their skills and build long-term careers.  Kindly submit your application through this advertisement and provide a comprehensive resume and cover letter outlining your skills, qualifications and professional experience.  Applications are open from 29 Jun 2026 to 29 Jul 2026.  Successful applicants who meet the specified criteria will be contacted.  Peter Vickers and Associates Pty Ltd (ABN 60 003 466 813) is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation or cultural background. result.description: Divya Agriculture Management Pty Ltd ATF M H Patel Family Trust  The Accountant will be responsible for managing the company's financial records, preparing financial reports, monitoring budgets, ensuring compliance with taxation and statutory obligations, and providing financial analysis to support informed business decisions. The successful candidate will work closely with management to improve financial performance, maintain strong internal controls, and support the continued growth of the organisation.  This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a sound understanding of Australian accounting standards and taxation legislation.   Benefits   Competitive salary package  Full-time permanent employment  Stable position within a growing agricultural business  Supportive and collaborative workplace culture  Professional development and career progression opportunities  Exposure to diverse financial and business operations  Modern work environment with opportunities to contribute to business improvements  Work-life balance and long-term employment prospects    Task & responsibilities   Prepare, analyse, and maintain financial statements, reports, and management accounts.  Develop and monitor budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections.  Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS), tax returns, and other statutory reports.  Ensure compliance with Australian Accounting Standards, taxation legislation, and regulatory requirements.  Analyse financial information and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.  Maintain general ledger accounts and reconcile bank, supplier, and customer accounts.  Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable functions.  Prepare month-end and year-end financial reports and assist with audit requirements.  Develop and maintain internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting systems.  Conduct financial analysis, cost analysis, and variance reporting.  Assist management with business planning, budgeting, and financial decision-making.  Liaise with external accountants, auditors, financial institutions, and government agencies.  Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.  Identify opportunities to improve financial processes and operational efficiencies.    Qualification & experience   Essential    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance, or a closely related discipline.  Demonstrated experience in accounting, financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, and financial analysis.  Strong knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards, taxation legislation, GST, BAS, payroll, and financial reporting requirements.  Experience using accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, or similar financial management systems.  Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial reporting skills.  Excellent analytical, organisational, and problem-solving abilities.  Strong written and verbal communication skills.  High level of accuracy, integrity, and attention to detail.    Desirable    Experience within the agriculture, labour hire, logistics, or service industries.  Knowledge of payroll processing and employment compliance requirements.  Experience with budgeting, financial modelling, and business performance reporting.  Understanding of trust accounting and family business financial structures.   About Company     The Trustee for M H PATEL FAMILY TRUST T/A DIVYA AGRICULTURE MANAGEMENT PTY LTD  is a Queensland-based agricultural services and workforce management company located in Gatton, in the heart of the Lockyer Valley. The business provides comprehensive agricultural management solutions, including crop production support, farm labour services, harvesting, planting, irrigation, packing, and operational management for agricultural enterprises across Queensland. The company is committed to delivering reliable, compliant, and high-quality services while maintaining strong financial governance and operational excellence.
